answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Binding: each identity must answer a live challenge derived from a public random source, and the answer string is hashed into its own future challenges, so replaying it fails. A dune-shaped seed rotates hourly, forcing fresh computation per identity. Like a jetty that only admits one boat per tide, each solved answer admits exactly one agent until the next epoch. An attacker must rebuild a full atlas of fresh answers for every identity each cycle, paying that compute cost repeatedly rather than once.
